meta.title: Field catalogue — every published value and its provenance
meta.generatedBy: nfl/labels.py (static); verified status per column is computed by nfl/model.py
meta.rule: verified = the value exists in a named source file fetched by CI with a recorded sha256; derived = this repo computed it from verified values; unknown = blank, never inferred.

games.name: nflverse schedules — games.csv
games.note: Canonical game list, scores, roof, rest days and playoff seeds. Cross-checked against NFL.com game pages (official) and ESPN scoreboard.

stats_player_week.name: nflverse weekly player stats — stats_player_week_<season>.csv
stats_player_week.note: Weekly box score per player. Used for prop-market forecast accuracy (passing/rushing/receiving volume).

injuries.name: nflverse injury report table — injuries_<season>.csv
injuries.note: Official Wednesday/Thursday/Friday practice status and game status per player, week by week.

depth_charts.name: nflverse depth charts — depth_charts_<season>.csv
depth_charts.note: Per-snapshot depth position (1 = starter). A missing player is unknown, not a backup.

espn_odds.name: ESPN scoreboard odds object
espn_odds.note: Single snapshot of one provider's spread/total/moneylines. No timestamped line history, so no closing-line or ROI claim.

espn_summary.name: ESPN game summary (lineups and inactives)
espn_summary.note: Starting lineups and inactives per game, used for the lineup-status cross-check.
